definitions.explanation: Material made from wood pulp, used for writing, printing, and wrapping. A basic everyday item.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}に{書|か}いてください。
{白|しろ}い{紙|かみ}がありますか。

notes:
Counter: {枚|まい} ({一|いち}{枚|まい}, one sheet). Don't confuse with {髪|かみ} (hair), which has the same reading but different kanji.

Related words:
- {折|お}り{紙|がみ} (origami)
- {新聞|しんぶん}{紙|し} (newspaper).
